description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Environmental Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: environmental-engineering

facts.claim: Public water supply delivers water via pumps and pipes

source.quote: usually via a system of pumps and pipes

facts.claim: Coagulation destabilises particles; flocculation forms flocs that settle

source.quote: flocculation is a process by which colloidal particles come out of suspension to sediment in the form of floc

facts.claim: Rapid mixing, then slow mixing, then sedimentation

source.quote: After the addition of flocculants, rapid mixing takes place, followed by slow mixing and later the sedimentation process

facts.claim: Rapid sand filters use coarse sand beds to remove particles

source.quote: The rapid sand filter or rapid gravity filter is a type of filter used in water purification

facts.claim: Distribution must keep adequate pressure in the pipes

source.quote: Hydraulic integrity is an ability to maintain adequate water pressure inside the pipes
Storage facilities, or distribution reservoirs, provide clean drinking water storage

facts.claim: Sewage is wastewater from homes and institutions

source.quote: Sewage (or domestic wastewater) consists of wastewater discharged from residences and from commercial, institutional and public facilities

facts.claim: BOD: oxygen consumed by microbes, usually 5 days at 20 °C
BOD and COD measure organic matter in water

source.quote: both measure the amount of organic compounds in water

facts.claim: Aeration plus a microbial floc oxidises organic pollutants

source.quote: using aeration and a biological floc composed of bacteria

facts.claim: Septic tanks: settling and anaerobic digestion (primary treatment)

source.quote: The term "septic" refers to the anaerobic bacterial environment that develops in the tank

facts.claim: Gases (e.g. NOx, ozone) and particles (soot, dust)

source.quote: Pollutants can be gases, like ozone or nitrogen oxides, or small particles like soot and dust
Noise exposure is quantified in terms of sound pressure levels measured in decibels (dB), a logarithmic scale

facts.claim: Repeated exposure above about 85 dB risks hearing loss

source.quote: repeated exposure above approximately 85 dB is associated with

facts.claim: Most MSW ends in landfills; collection and transport come first

source.quote: the disposal of wastes by land filling or land spreading is the ultimate fate of all solid wastes

facts.claim: Plumbing conveys fluids with pipes, valves and fixtures

source.quote: Plumbing uses pipes, valves, plumbing fixtures, tanks, and other apparatuses to convey fluids
